jsesh.uiFramework
Class BundledAction

java.lang.Object
  javax.swing.AbstractAction
      jsesh.uiFramework.BundledAction
All Implemented Interfaces:
javax.swing.Action, java.awt.event.ActionListener, java.lang.Cloneable, java.util.EventListener, java.io.Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
JSeshBundledAction
public class BundledAction
extends javax.swing.AbstractAction

Action which takes (most of) its informations from a ressource bundle. from an article by Hans Muller on java.net. Lots of bells and wistles added (too many ?).

Constructor Detail

BundledAction

public BundledAction(PropertyHolder target,
                     java.lang.String actionName,
                     AppDefaults defaults)
Create an action which will take most of its data from a property file.

This allows multilingual softwares and the like.

When the action is called, a specific method will be called on the target object. If the "method" name contains underscores, the parts after the underscores will be understood as arguments (of type String).

Parameters:
target - the object the action will apply to.
actionName - the name of this action (in reality, the name of the method plus its arguments).
defaults - the bundle of properties to use.
